fact: The report for October-December 2024 lists among its issues of concern the continued use of MVRS at health facilities, in most private (UCMB) facilities and at Mulago Hospital, in place of DHIS2 data entry, and inefficient transfer of cause-of-death data from DHIS2 to the NIRA CRVS system because the two bodies' administrative units do not match; it gives no count of facilities.
title: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics-Uganda Progress Report – October-December 2024
publisher: Bloomberg Data for Health Initiative (D4H)-Uganda/U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and CDC Foundation
